annotations.title: List your recent calls and charges

description: Free; reads only. Lists your recent account calls, newest first: the tool, whether it succeeded, failed or is still running, what it was charged (failed calls cost $0) and its request id, plus the total charged on the page. Use it to review spending or find a request id for get_call. Filter by status, page back with before (the next value from the previous page). Needs an account API key on the connection; x402 calls are paid from your own wallet and show in its history instead.

before.description: Only calls made before this time (ISO 8601). Use the createdAt of the last call on the previous page.

limit.description: How many calls to return, 1 to 50. Default 20.

status.description: Only calls with this status. Leave out for all.
